meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比本地代码与已发布版本，列出未发布的变更
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要知道哪些代码改动还没发布到npm
copy.tagline_en: Compare local code with published npm versions and list unpublished changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know which code changes are not yet published to npm

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会对比当前代码与最新发布的 npm 版本，按组件层、OpenCode 层、Codex 层列出所有未发布的变更，并描述每个变更的实际内容和影响。
howto.when: 当你提到“未发布的变更”、“更新日志”、“有什么变化”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 检查一下有哪些未发布的变更。
say.note: Claude 会分析并列出变更。

say.text: 对比当前代码和最新 npm 版本，有什么不同？
say.note: Claude 会执行 git diff 并分类。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude compares the current code with the latest published npm versions, lists all unpublished changes by release layer (pure components, opencode, codex), and describes each change's actual content and impact.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'unpublished changes', 'changelog', 'what changed', or 'what's new'.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze and list changes.

say_en.text: Compare current code with the latest npm version, what's different?
say_en.note: Claude will run git diff and categorize.
